high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "art_dailydose," which is verified by a blue checkmark. The post features a detailed pencil drawing of a cat. The cat is depicted in a side profile, facing to the right, with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. The drawing is highly detailed, showcasing the texture and fur of the cat through various shades of gray. The cat's eyes are large and expressive, adding a sense of life to the illustration. The background is plain white, which helps to emphasize the intricate details of the drawing.
